AUDIENCE: new and returning Cherokee language learners
PILOT_GOAL: This pilot adds repeatable writing practice that can be used in class, at home, or in lab sessions.
KEYBOARD_NOTES: If key output is unexpected, re-check browser focus and selected keyboard input mode before retrying.
LEARNING_PATH_NOTES: Short, frequent sessions are preferred over occasional long sessions.
TEACHER_NOTES: Encourage retries and reward measurable improvement in accuracy first, then speed.
CLOSING_MESSAGE: The main value is practical: consistent, measurable writing practice in Moodle.
